ItemID: NA; Title: Chronicle: 20 Greatest 1976; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: A strong match for my recent interest in classic rock hits and familiar older songs.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best Of Daryl Hall & John Oates; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Familiar melodic pop-rock fits my taste for The Cars and greatest-hits collections.
ItemID: NA; Title: Simon and Garfunkel's Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Very close to my taste, but I would skip it this time because I already interacted with another Simon & Garfunkel compilation.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Sheryl Crow; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in older classic-rock and folk-pop collections right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Nick Of Time; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This specific album has a weaker connection to my recent choices than the familiar hits collections.
ItemID: NA; Title: Glen Campbell: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: His melodic older songs appeal to the softer side of my interest in Jonathan Edwards and mid-'60s hits.
ItemID: NA; Title: Abba Gold: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Catchy, familiar pop songs fit my interest in pop albums and greatest-hits collections.
ItemID: NA; Title: 20th Century Masters: The Millennium Collection - The Best of Atlanta Rhythm Section; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The classic-rock connection interests me, but I would choose the more familiar collections first.
ItemID: NA; Title: All Time Greatest Hits: Roger Miller; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a strong enough interest in his country-oriented songs to choose this now.
